fact: At the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications workshop of 17-18 February 2026 the CNPS Director General said AI tools are in use at the social insurance fund for insured-person data, fraud detection, real-time rights calculation, automated document issuing, a biometric facial recognition system and an automatic response system for clients.
title: At gov't Artificial Intelligence workshop: CNPS Director General showcases AI use in social security services
